name: glyph-plot
title: Glyph plot
description: The raster behind the asciicn charts: sub-cell dots plotted with Bresenham lines and fills, turned into Braille or quadrant glyphs and rendered as copyable DOM text.

name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: A donut or pie chart drawn in Braille dots or quadrant blocks, one colour per slice, with clean gaps, a centre readout and a tooltip.

name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: Series across several axes, drawn in Braille: dotted rings and spokes, one-dot outlines, a light dot fill and an axis readout.

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: A gauge for one reading, drawn as a Braille arc with ticks, threshold zones and a needle option, or as a single row of eighth blocks.

name: uptime-bar
title: Uptime bar
description: A status-page row of half-block glyph columns, one per day, with a height and colour per status and details for each day.

name: dot-map
title: Dot map
description: A flat world map in Braille or halftone dots, with markers that pulse rings, dotted arcs with light running along them, and highlighted regions.
